content:
You know that feeling of little bit of regret after shopping?

That moment when the bags are full,

the bank balance is not, and suddenly the purchase starts looking slightly less necessary.

That’s where I started with Kiwi.

The brief was to communicate Real cashback on every UPI spent with Kiwi.

And since people are already spending inside a mall, 

I thought the medium could acknowledge exactly what they were doing.

So instead of telling people to shop less, the screens simply say:

More shopping. Less regret.

Because spending is probably happening anyway.

Might as well get something real back from it.

Made this using ChatGPT.

If you've got a better line than mine, Rekha and Ashu, now's the time to prove it.

comment: The interesting challenge is keeping cashback from becoming just another discount message. The strongest executions make the reward feel like part of the behaviour, not a bribe to spend more.
